    • factorForDate

      public double factorForDate(LocalDate date)
      The factor by which the close of a date is multiplied: the product of the factors of all ex-dates after it.
      Parameters:
      date - the date of the price
      Returns:
      the factor, 1 when no ex-date follows

    • growthBetween

      public double growthBetween(LocalDate startExclusive, LocalDate endInclusive)
      The growth that the reinvested dividends add between two dates: the product of the factors of the ex-dates in (startExclusive, endInclusive]. A total return change is last / (closeStart * growth) - 1.
      Parameters:
      startExclusive - date of the starting price
      endInclusive - date of the final price
      Returns:
      the product of the factors, 1 without an ex-date in between

    • hasExDateBetween

      public boolean hasExDateBetween(LocalDate fromExclusive, LocalDate toInclusive)
      Tells whether a usable dividend has its ex-date in (fromExclusive, toInclusive].
      Parameters:
      fromExclusive - start of the period
      toInclusive - end of the period
      Returns:
      true when at least one ex-date lies within
